faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Lavcom Performances
faq.q1: How does Lavcom Performances connect to my machines?
faq.a1: Lavcom Performances integrates easily with most payment and laundry management systems. Our technical team will guide you through the initial setup, which typically takes less than 2 hours. No hardware modifications are required.
faq.a2: Absolutely. All your data is encrypted and stored on secure servers in Europe. We are GDPR compliant and never share your information with third parties. You remain 100% owner of your data.
faq.q3: Can I manage multiple laundromats with one account?
faq.a3: Yes! Lavcom Performances is designed to manage a single laundromat as well as a complete network. You can view the performance of each location individually or get a consolidated view of your entire network.
faq.q4: How long is the free trial?
faq.a4: You get a 14-day free trial with access to all features. No credit card is required to start. At the end of the trial, you choose the plan that suits you.
faq.a5: Our system continuously analyzes your machine data to detect anomalies before they cause breakdowns. You receive alerts by email or SMS with precise action recommendations. This allows you to intervene preventively and significantly reduce downtime.
faq.q6: What support is included in the subscription?
faq.a6: All our subscriptions include email support with a response within 24 hours. Pro and Business plans benefit from priority phone support and personalized guidance to optimize platform usage.
